newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close higher across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close higher across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed higher across the board in moderate trade on some late buying interest in line with higher Japanese prices, brokers said on Wednesday.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were marked up slightly supported by firmer Thai rubber offer prices to Japan and the yen's further slip against the U.S. dollar.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning but prices were marked up slightly in the afternoon as some speculative buying emerged in sympathy with higher prices in Tokyo and Kobe. But activity was limited by the continued lack of Chinese inquiries," a local broker said.
"Prices ended firmer today but activity was rather thin as most people have closed or are closing their books for the upcoming Lunar New Year and Hari Raya Puasa holiday," another broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, March RSS3 rose 1.50 cents to 121.50 U.S. cents a kg.
May RSS3 rose three cents to 175.75 Singapore cents (US$1.25) a kg
April TSR20 was indicated AT 169.00 Singapore cents (US$1.20) a kg compared with Tuesday's settlement of 167.50 cents. (US$1-S$1.41) - P. Theseira (65-870-3085)
